items.text:
Quarterly Sales Report — Q2 2025
Prepared by: Marcus Chen, Revenue Operations

Overall performance: Total bookings reached $4.12M, up 8.3% quarter-over-quarter, driven primarily by the EMEA region (+14.2%) and the new partner channel. North America remained flat at $2.31M, while APAC dipped 2.1% due to currency headwinds. The top three products by revenue were Atlas Core ($1.44M), Beacon Analytics ($987K), and Summit Connect ($612K). Renewal rate held steady at 91.4%.

Key wins: We closed 14 enterprise deals over $50K, including Hartwell Logistics ($120K ARR) and Pinnacle Health ($95K ARR). The mid-market segment added 37 new logos, with average deal size rising to $18.7K. Churn was concentrated in the SMB tier, where 22 accounts representing $84K ARR lapsed.

Operational notes: The sales team headcount grew to 48 with 6 new hires in Q2. Ramp time for new reps averaged 71 days. The CRM migration to Salesforce completed on May 12, with no major data loss reported.
